SPEC GAP: the spec defines no tick size and no rounding rule. Expected values are the unrounded arithmetic. Half-up rounding to 0.01 gives 1994.88 / 2045.13; round-half-even gives 1994.88 / 2045.12. The rounding rule must be written into the spec before this case can be marked derived.
